name: ldk-linear-project-ops
description: Role-based Linear delivery with lifecycle-aware Project status, native planning, project updates, and safe cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver work through role-based Linear handoffs.
interface.longDescription: A human-oriented workflow that maps strategy to native Linear hierarchy, keeps Project lifecycle status aligned with execution evidence, performs issues by responsible role, publishes evidence-based project updates, and safely cleans legacy artifacts.
capabilities: Project lifecycle consistency and safe status transitions
Assignee, estimate, cycle and due-date planning
defaultPrompt: Create native Linear initiatives, milestones, resources, and role-owned issues from this product brief.
Perform issue LDK-123 according to its current role and state.
Report Project lifecycle consistency and propose the correct live Linear status.
